catalysts.headline: Q4 FY2026: revenue $137.2M (down from $144.8M in Q3, missed ~$157.1M consensus); net loss $684.0M incl. $450.4M in asset impairments; AI Cloud revenue grew sequentially from $33.6M to $70.5M (+110% QoQ), now over half of quarterly revenue; adjusted EBITDA $19.2M (~53% below expectations). FY2026 full year: revenue $707.0M (up from $501.0M), net loss $702.6M vs FY2025 net income $86.9M. Guided FY2027 capex of $25B-$30B, with roughly $8B of funding still needed.

notes: Theme 'Crypto Treasury & Miners' is kept per the reuse rule, but it is an increasingly imprecise fit: IREN's Q4 FY2026 AI Cloud revenue ($70.5M) was already more than half of total quarterly revenue ($137.2M), and the company's own disclosures and guidance (FY2027 capex of $25B-$30B) now frame it primarily as an AI-cloud/data-center infrastructure operator rather than a pure bitcoin miner. This mismatch was already flagged by a prior pass; not changed here to avoid fragmenting the taxonomy without a clearer signal on what the replacement theme string should be system-wide.
